about: With more than 30 years of dedicated legal practice in Dallas, Texas, Sanjay S. Mathur serves as the founder and principal attorney of Mathur Law Offices, P.C. He is widely acknowledged for his extensive competence in family law, immigration, criminal defense, civil and business litigation, business law, estate planning and personal injury, and he represents individuals and families throughout the Dallas–Fort Worth metropolitan area.

Leveraging a commitment to client advocacy and ethical excellence, Mr. Mathur emphasizes personalized strategies tailored to each case’s unique circumstances. After graduating with a Bachelor of Arts cum laude in political science from Texas A&M University, he earned his Juris Doctor from Southern Methodist University’s Dedman School of Law.

During his time in law school, Mr. Mathur belonged to the Southern Methodist University Board of Advocates and participated in the Criminal Clinic. He is admitted to practice before all Texas state courts, the Supreme Court of Texas, the U.S. District Courts for the District of Texas, Nebraska and Arkansas, and the U.S. Courts of Appeals for the 5th and 11th Circuits.

Throughout his distinguished career, Mr. Mathur has received numerous honors from leading legal institutions. The American Institute of Family Law Attorneys has consistently named him among its “10 Best” attorneys, and in 2021 the American Institute of Legal Counsel bestowed the same distinction. His exemplary achievements also earned him a place on Attorney and Practice magazine’s “Top 10” list, as well as inclusion in the National Advocates’ “Top 100 Lawyers.”

Certified by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization in immigration and nationality law, Mr. Mathur brings formidable litigation and trial advocacy skills to both criminal and civil proceedings. A proud member of the Texas Bar College, he remains active in professional organizations such as the Dallas Bar Association, the Dallas Trial Lawyers Association, the State Bar of Texas, the Tarrant County Criminal Defense Lawyers Association, the Denton County Criminal Defense Lawyers Associations and the American Immigration Lawyers Association.
